notes:
PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). This package is model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json authored_by is the deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 model with run_id ros-wave-c-060, reviewed_by remains null, no human reviewed or tested anything, no hardware was attached, and no ROS graph, Gazebo world or DAVE simulation is claimed. The card names the ros family and the RosDriver helper; that matches the pinned repository's ROS 1 plugin interfaces and is used without deviation. The card's entry_symbols list is empty, so there was no Python entry symbol to verify, and no native.py exists. Scope: the ocean-current environment defined by gazebo/dave_gazebo_ros_plugins/src/ocean_current_plugin.cpp. The package binds the geometry_msgs/TwistStamped current topic (resolved /hydrodynamics/current_velocity; source token current_velocity at gazebo/dave_gazebo_world_plugins/src/ocean_current_world_plugin.cc:170-175, advertise at ocean_current_plugin.cpp:79-81, type include at ocean_current_plugin.h:36), the relative get_current_velocity_model service (ocean_current_plugin.cpp:99-103, type include ocean_current_plugin.h:25), the relative get_current_horz_angle_model service (112-115), and the relative set_current_velocity service (129-133, type include ocean_current_plugin.h:26). A shipped world loads libdave_ocean_current_plugin.so with namespace hydrodynamics and topic current_velocity (models/dave_worlds/worlds/dave_ocean_waves_dvl_current_profiling.world:85-88); a deployment with another namespace or remapping must expose the resolved endpoints. Namespace and remapping assumptions are not upstream facts. The resource state exposes the configured velocity and horizontal-angle models through the two GetCurrentModel services. NOT COVERED: the stratified-current topics and services, the spherical-coordinate interface, the get_current_vert_angle_model service (it is advertised with the GetCurrentHorzAngleModel callback at ocean_current_plugin.cpp:123-127 and returns horizontal-angle data, so the driver does not expose it), robot thruster/manipulator dynamics, DAVE/Gazebo sensors, Gazebo stepping, pause and reset, and every other repository package. No vehicle motion or simulation stepping is commanded or claimed. Safety: the input-free zero_current action and the native e-stop binding send a fixed /hydrodynamics/set_current_velocity request with velocity, horizontal_angle and vertical_angle all zero. The callback calls SetMean on the three model means in a short-circuit && chain (ocean_current_plugin.cpp:319-341); SetMean stores the mean and resets the process variable to it (gauss_markov_process.cc:36-50), so the next world update computes a zero current vector when the configured ranges contain zero. This is a simulated current-forcing stop, not a physical emergency stop: it does not pause Gazebo, stop a robot, cancel another ROS client or prove that a later world update ran. A deployment whose configured range excludes zero gets success=false and the service predicate refuses to claim a safe state. Because the native callback short-circuits, a rejected later field can leave an earlier accepted mean changed; the fake mirrors this partial application and the local tests cover it. The three set-current inputs are Limit.operator_required: the clone reads the model min/max/mu/noise from the deployed world SDF (ocean_current_world_plugin.cc:180-204) and states no fixed device bound. The shipped current-profiling world's 0..5 m/s and +/-pi rad values (world:89-111) are recorded as configuration facts, not limits. site-limits.example.json is an example-only operator envelope and was not supplied as live configuration; after a site document is supplied, the runtime enforces it. The fake keeps the native wire shapes, the success application predicate, a transport failure and an application rejection. The fake is a ROS-free canned-response RecordingRosTransport, F0, with every current/model number marked # placeholder; it is not a captured transcript and its fidelity gaps disclose the absent Gazebo world, DAVE plugin, Gauss-Markov process, physics, sensors and wall clock. The card's mock_strategy.preferred is upstream-sim; no ROS 1 Noetic/Gazebo 11 stack was installed or executed (no network, no pip install, no upstream run), so the deployed fake is the SDK's ROS-free canned-response transport, not a replay of captured DAVE traffic. Determinism is none, timestep_ms is 0, realtime_factor is 0, reset is none and snapshot/restore is absent. test_driver.py keeps check_driver and adds thirteen local cases: current-vector observation, resource model reads, exact service request mapping, observable model-state change, the operator-required refusal and example overlay, zero-current state change without latching, native application rejection, native service failure, partial short-circuit application, failed and malformed replies through the actual native e-stop path, and the latched e-stop refusal of both the observational read action and set_current. All 21 facts cite the pinned clone at e54ea16bdaf7d6dbb466cf141846a03f284a44dd and no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings remain. The final gate run reported all gates pass (G1-G9) with no warnings, and the clone was left unmodified. No network, pip install, upstream execution or hardware [...]

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Checked the TwistStamped current topic, the two GetCurrentModel reads and the set_current_velocity binding against ocean_current_plugin.cpp, the world plugin, gauss_markov_process.cc, the srv files and the shipped worlds and vehicle xacros at the pin, all 21 facts, the three operator_required inputs and the zero-current stop. The safe_state overstated the stop: set_current_velocity(0, 0, 0) zeroes only the global constant-current Gauss-Markov means, while the world plugin also keeps per-row stratified-database models and the ROS plugin republishes the database with its tidal data every period (ocean_current_world_plugin.cc:376-411, ocean_current_plugin.cpp:170-254), from which vehicles carrying the transient-current model plugin compute their own flow (ocean_current_model_plugin.cc:209-213 and 309-336, rexrov_oberon7_transient_current.xacro:82-104); Update keeps adding noiseAmp noise (gauss_markov_process.cc:75-87); and any ROS client can set a new current through the plugin's eight other setters (93-163). One fact cited the world plugin for the ROS plugin's ros::isInitialized guard and NodeHandle (now ocean_current_plugin.cpp:63-77), one asserted the NED frame although the plugin logs ENU (ocean_current_world_plugin.cc:94-96), and three said more than their lines. The reviewer rewrote safe_state, the docstring, the zero-current and current-vector descriptions and added four gaps, corrected five facts, widened one binding range and added ten facts (driver.py); added an e-stop case for a configured range that excludes zero, which fails with SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED with the latch held and the velocity mean already zero (test_driver.py); updated facts.md; and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The gate and collect.py --strict pass with the digest unchanged and the 14 package cases pass; the author's notes above still say the next world update computes a zero current vector without these exceptions. For the human reviewer: Simulation only (DAVE on Gazebo, ROS 1). The e-stop zeroes the global constant current only: vehicles spawned from the *_transient_current xacros keep their stratified-database and tidal current, Gazebo and the vehicles keep running, and any ROS client can set a new current or model through the plugin's other services after the stop. With noiseAmp above zero the current random-walks away from zero again. The clone is ambiguous about the vector's frame (comment NED, log lines ENU), and upstream wires get_current_vert_angle_model to the horizontal-angle callback.
